pattern.description: A tear-off calendar countdown: a white rounded card reading '60 DAYS TO PRODUCTION' sits on a stack; each top card rotates and flies off toward the lower right with a soft shadow, revealing a lower number underneath, accelerating through 59, 56, 40, 22, 11, 6 until the final '5' card settles larger with a green accent rule drawn above it.
pattern.why_premium: It makes the 'days, not months' claim physical: real card flips with 3D tilt and contact shadows, an accelerating rhythm that builds tension, and a calm, enlarged landing on the final number synced to the narration word 'days'.

build_hint.gsap: Stack of card nodes (60..5) with only the top visible; tl = gsap.timeline(); cards.forEach((c,i) => tl.to(c, {rotation: 25, x: 380, y: 160, rotationX: 30, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.in'}, '>-' + (0.25 * Math.min(1, i/6)))) with timeScale ramp (tl.timeScale ramping 1 -> 3 via gsap.to(tl, {timeScale: 3, duration: 1.5, ease: 'power1.in'})); final card: to({scale: 1.2, duration: 0.5, ease: 'back.out(1.2)'}); accent: fromTo('.rule', {scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: 'left'}, {scaleX: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power3.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: For each card i, start = cumulative frames with shrinking gaps (e.g. gap = max(2, 10 - i)); progress = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 10], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) driving rotate/translate/opacity; final card scale via spring({frame: frame - endStart, fps, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 140}}); rule scaleX interpolate with Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

notes: b01 is a union box spanning the card plus the right-hand flight path of discarded cards; no candidate isolates the card alone. Countdown values are read from filmstrip frames, not all intermediate numbers are visible. Whether the final card actually scales up or the camera pushes in is ambiguous (camera verdict none, scale sum 0.81 reflects content change).
